authority: test-only source evidence and a bounded Lean projection; no production, solver, source-language, fixture, dependency, or expected-output change

request_observation_snapshot.source: the exact observation vector stored on this native request and passed to this local_grant call; retained independently in test-only RequestConsumerEvidence
request_observation_snapshot.selected_callback_observation_index: index of the exact member whose CallbackResult handle and callback_grant guard succeeds
request_observation_snapshot.execution_table: ordered projection copied from the owning Receiving.executions store
request_observation_snapshot.validation: compare candidate observation to the independent request-owned snapshot field-for-field; do not compare duplicated candidate fields to each other

local_grant.callback_grant_result: computed result of the actual callback_grant call; never an unexplained theorem premise
local_grant.local_grant_result: computed result of the actual local_grant call over the request-owned observation vector

catch_consumer.handler_id: dynamic HandlerInstallation.occurrence of the selected installation, not source-site occurrence
catch_consumer.installation_owner: actual owner of the selected dynamic installation
catch_consumer.installation_authenticated: selected installation is read from the owning installed-handler table

companion.rule: companion frame/template evidence is never used as callback-entry, callback-use, request-observation, or Grant evidence

mutations.rule: a mutation counts only when the intended present field changes and the independent validator rejects it; absent/no-op targets are not passes

required_targets: CatchReady when all source-owned premises are present
lean_projection.history: construct only if actual source transitions justify every Step; otherwise explicitly OPEN
